# GoPackNow

> AI-powered collaborative group travel planner. Friend groups add wishes, vote on activities, and let Claude build a personalized day-by-day itinerary — plus a smart packing list.

GoPackNow makes group trip planning effortless. Members join a shared trip, wish for activities they want to do, vote on everyone's ideas, and then generate a complete AI itinerary in one click. The app also generates a custom packing list based on the destination, vibe, and group budget.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://gopacknow.replit.app/) — marketing landing page with product overview
- [Explore](https://gopacknow.replit.app/explore) — browse and discover public trips for inspiration

## Product highlights

- Collaborative wishlisting and upvoting within a shared trip
- One-click AI itinerary generation powered by Anthropic Claude
- AI packing list tailored to destination, trip vibe, and budget
- Realtime group chat per trip
- Invite-link sharing so anyone can join a trip instantly
